name: Two-Path Decision
summary: A five-card branched spread evaluating two diverging choices, their proximate consequences, and core synthesis.
author: Traditional

instructions.preparation: Clearly state Choice A and Choice B as mutually exclusive options.
instructions.shuffle: Shuffle while holding the intention of unbiased clarity.
instructions.drawing: Card 1 at the base is Current Crossroads. Left wing: Card 2 (Path A), Card 4 (Outcome A). Right wing: Card 3 (Path B), Card 5 (Outcome B).
instructions.synthesis: Compare the energetic resonance between the left branch (Path A) and the right branch (Path B).

slots.description: Current status, heart of the decision, and fundamental dilemma.
The nature, energetic commitment, and experience of selecting Option A.
The nature, energetic commitment, and experience of selecting Option B.
The likely long-term outcome and harvest of proceeding with Path A.
The likely long-term outcome and harvest of proceeding with Path B.
